地域ID。

您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~146965~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en:
The region ID.

Call [DescribeRegions](~~146965~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh: 要查询的抢占式实例的资源信息。
description.en: The information about the spot instance resource to query.

description.zh:
可用区ID。

默认值为空，此时查询指定地域下的所有可用区。
description.en:
The zone ID.

If you do not specify this parameter, all zones in the specified region are queried.

descriptions.zh: 调用CreateContainerGroup创建ECI实例时支持通过InstanceType参数来指定ECS规格，以满足特定的规格需求。为保证ECI实例能够创建成功，在创建ECI实例前，您可以先调用本接口查询指定地域和可用区下支持哪些ECS实例规格或实例规格族。
descriptions.en: When you call the CreateContainerGroup operation to create an ECI instance, you can use the InstanceType parameter to specify an ECS instance type to meet specific requirements. To ensure that the ECI instance is created successfully, first call this operation to query the supported ECS instance types or instance families in a specific region and zone.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci describe-available-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-e --destination-resource Cores=2.0 Category=InstanceTypeFamily Memory=4.0 Value=ecs.c6 --spot-resource SpotPriceLimit=0.2 SpotDuration=1 SpotStrategy=SpotAsPriceGo --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eci DescribeAvailableResource --region cn-hangzhou --DestinationResource.Memory '4.0' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-e' --DestinationResource.Category InstanceTypeFamily --SpotResource.SpotDuration 1 --SpotResource.SpotPriceLimit '0.2' --DestinationResource.Value 'ecs.c6' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DestinationResource.Cores '2.0' --SpotResource.SpotStrategy SpotAsPriceGo --method POST --force
